_doc: Races for the Workshop's Races tab. Each race has three mannequin builds (<race>.unisex, <race>.male, <race>.female) in the puppet-ready A-pose. The unisex front is txt2img from the chosen `style_groups` of specs/ai_style.json + `pose` + race traits/description + the unisex body + `base_body` (or, with `from`, an edit of that race's approved unisex front using `from_edit`); male and female fronts are edits of the race's approved unisex front that keep the head, face, pose, scale and feet and the smooth base body; every back is an edit of its approved front. The base is a smooth, featureless, unclothed doll body so clothing is generated per gender later. Skin tones: ramps in specs/palettes.json (group skin) whose `races` include the race id.
pose: full body, three-quarter view facing left, seen slightly from above, standing in an A-pose: both arms held straight out and down at about 30 degrees away from the body with white space between each arm and the torso, legs apart at shoulder width, feet flat, floating in empty space

sexes.unisex: an androgynous adult with a neutral, average build, an unclothed mannequin body that is completely smooth and featureless like a plastic toy doll, no anatomical details, bald head, barefoot, neutral expression
sexes.male: an adult male build: broader shoulders, a flat chest, narrower hips and slightly more muscular arms, athletic build, clay model, clay render, 3D modeled, hand painted, AAA quality, clean open hands, hard shadows, sculpted figure, stark lighting.
sexes.female: an adult female build: narrower shoulders, perky bust, supple, wider hips and a defined waist, athletic build, clay model, clay render, 3D modeled, hand painted, AAA quality, clean open hands, hard shadows, sculpted figure, stark lighting.

elf.name: Elf
elf.traits: elf, long pointed elf ears, slender graceful features
elf.from_edit: Give this character long pointed elf ears and slightly more slender, graceful facial features. Keep the body, pose, scale, position and art style exactly the same.
